title: SSL Handshake Exception with Tidepool uploading
symptom: When trying to test the Tidepool login within xDrip, an SSL handshake exception error occurs, despite correct username and password. The user is using the latest nightly build (23 February) on an old phone running Android 4.4.
cause: Tidepool has a restrictive set of ciphers available that older Android devices are unable to connect with.
evidence_quote: Tidepool has such a restrictive set of ciphers available that much older android devices are unable to connect with it.
